newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels on bids and offers on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Tuesday versus eight barges traded on Monday, Exchange sources said.
- Two barges, this week, Illinois River, bid 150 percent of tariff, offered 160 percent, down five percentage points.
- Ten barges, two each week of December, Illinois River, bid 145 percent, unchanged from Monday, offer 150 percent, unchanged.
- Ten barges, two each week of December, lower Ohio River, no bid, offer 125 percent, unchanged from Monday.
- Five barges, one each week December, St Louis, Mississippi, no bid, offer 117-1/2 percent.
